Courage—vulnerable hone ki willingness se shuru.
Sahi shabd bhi kaam aata hai, lekin koi bhi shabd khamoshi ko nahi badal sakta.
Jo zaroori hai, jaldi nahi hota.
Khamosh dimag wars jeet sakte hain.
Khatre ko jaankar bhi aage badhna.
Toofan ka saamna karo.
Bahadur log kabhi nahi marte.
Grit mehnat aur ghisai hai.
Silence folly ke against ek fence hai.
Change ki hawa chal rahi—use tumhe change karne do.
Safalta antim nahi hai, vipalta ghatak nahi hai: aage badhte rehne ka saahas hi maayne rakhta hai.
Khamoshi buddhimani hai.
Samajhdaar tab bolte hain jab zaroorat ho.
Quietness ultimate conquest hai.
Shaant dimaag ko uljhaya ya daraya nahi ja sakta.
Grit aam logon ko mahan banata.
Bade kaamon mein waqt lagta hai.
Khamoshi mein matlab milta.
Grit ichha hai.
Zarurat par bol, hamesha chup.
